newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO shields Israeli soldiers besieged in Nablus.
newsitem.headline: PLO shields Israeli soldiers besieged in Nablus.

text.p: Palestinian security forces protected 42 Israeli soldiers trapped at a West Bank shrine after angry demonstrators and policemen overran an Israeli position on Thursday, witnesses said.

Israeli army general Uzi Dayan said a "real battle" took place around the tomb of the biblical Joseph in Nablus. He said Israeli soldiers were killed and wounded when they came under fire from Palestinian police.
Palestinian witnesses said PLO policemen were keeping dozens of angry demonstrators away from the shrine and caring for the Israeli soldiers as negotiators tried to secure their freedom.
Witnesses said they saw two Israeli armoured personnel carriers and at least six Israeli army jeeps consumed by fire around the site. Damage to the building was evident.
"We are trying to solve this ordeal peacefully," said Nablus governor Mahmoud al-Alloul. Officers said there were 42 soldiers inside the domed above-ground tomb made of yellow stone.
Witnesses said Palestinian policemen brought the trapped Israelis soft drinks and water and gave them cellular phones to call their families.

Palestinian officials said Israeli soldiers had removed four dead comrades and two wounded from the shrine. Earlier, Israeli army radio said two Israeli soldiers were killed in battles with Palestinians at the site.
Israel had deployed armoured personnel carriers at the entrance to Nablus after Palestinian demonstrators burned several Israeli jeeps used to try to rescue the soldiers.

"There was a real battle there," Dayan, the Israeli commander in charge of the West Bank, said of the fighting around the tomb. A Palestinian flag was flying on the building instead of the Israeli flag, witnesses said.
At least 33 Palestinians were killed in running battles across the West Bank and Gaza Strip on Thursday. Israel Radio said 10 Israeli soldiers were killed.

Under a self-rule deal which expanded Palestinian self-rule in the West Bank, Israel kept control of the shrine, which is holy to Jews and Moslems. Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority controls the rest of the city of 130,000 Arabs.
Israel Radio had earlier said that Israeli attempts to retake the shrine had failed.

"At Joseph's Tomb, near Nablus, there is a fierce fight...An attempt to break in and rescue the forces from Joseph's Tomb didn't go well and during it several Israeli army jeeps went up in flames," the radio said.
